speakers.name: You don't need Fable for that: comparing Jev, open models, and classical ML approach to text classification
speakers.info: When you have a powerful hammer, everything looks like a nail. But many tasks can be done faster and cheaper using smaller, local, or specialized models. We'll compare how several different approaches fare on a typical AI task: text classification.
speakers.bio: Senko Rašić has been a software engineer and an active member of the Croatian developer community for several decades, creating a Linux distribution, cofounding the local Ubuntu user group and the WebCamp Zagreb conference. He maintains Cijene API, an open-source project that collects 10 million retail prices a day. Today at VibeScale he helps companies adopt AI in their software development practices and integrate AI into their products.

speakers.name: Loop engineering
speakers.info: Move beyond constant prompting and build systems where AI works in a loop while you oversee the process. Discover Loop Engineering: give AI larger tasks and spend less time micromanaging every step. Then look beyond development: you’ve built it - now what? Explore how marketing, sales, and distribution become essential parts of building something successful.
speakers.bio: Josip is a software developer with deep experience in Flutter, native iOS and Android, web, and Firebase. With over 50 apps shipped, he combines modern AI-driven workflows without AI vibe-coded slop. Organizer of Flutter Croatia.

speakers.name: AI Is a Good Developer. Be an Excellent One.
speakers.info: AI can now do what a good developer does: take a clear spec and write code that works. So what's left for us? Everything that makes a developer excellent. Drawing on his journey from designer to founder to Head of Product, Robert breaks down the difference between good and excellent developers, from questioning the ticket instead of just building it to knowing when the AI is confidently wrong. With everyday analogies and real stories from building products and teams, this talk is for students wondering if they'll have a job in five years and seniors deciding what to grow into next.
speakers.bio: Robert is Head of Product at Barricade Systems in Norway. He started as a designer and became creative director for some of Romania's most successful educational books for kids. Since then, he has shipped his own games to every major platform, helped launch dozens of apps with millions of downloads, built platforms for the NHS, construction companies and Silicon Valley startups, and founded his own company. He builds and leads product teams, and believes job titles are a starting point, not a limit.
